title: Stagsden Halifax Memorial
memorial_details: Stained-glass window to Sgt P.R. Jeffries (aged 19) in St Leonard's Church, Stagsden, Bedfordshire.
narrative: Halifax MZ492 of 640 Squadron, coded C8-X, departed Leconfield at 2036 on 2 February 1945 for the Wanne-Eickel oil plant. The aircraft crashed into Lakes Wood near Lockington at 2048, just twelve minutes after take-off. Six crew were killed; the rear gunner survived badly injured. Sgt P.R. Jeffries, aged just 19, is commemorated in the stained-glass window at St Leonard's Church, Stagsden.

sources.title: Chorley, W.R. — Bomber Command Losses Vol. 6
Tony Hibberd (RAF Bomber Command Memorials Facebook group, admin post)
